```{r}
read_safe <- function(path) {
  if (!file.exists(path)) return(NULL)
  utils::read.csv(path, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}

paths <- list(
  exp_a_summary = file.path("artefacts", "canonical_runs", "experiment_a_presence_removal_v2", "experiment_a_summary_v2.csv"),
  exp_a_delta = file.path("artefacts", "canonical_runs", "experiment_a_presence_removal_v2", "experiment_a_delta_ensemble_v2.csv"),
  exp_a_claims = file.path("artefacts", "canonical_runs", "experiment_a_presence_removal_v2", "experiment_a_claims_v2.csv"),
  exp_a_units = file.path("artefacts", "canonical_runs", "experiment_a_presence_removal_v2", "experiment_a_summary_v2_units.csv"),
  exp_c_summary = file.path("artefacts", "canonical_runs", "experiment_c_aridity_gradient_v2", "experiment_c_summary_v2.csv"),
  exp_c_claims = file.path("artefacts", "canonical_runs", "experiment_c_aridity_gradient_v2", "experiment_c_claims_v2.csv"),
  exp_c_units = file.path("artefacts", "canonical_runs", "experiment_c_aridity_gradient_v2", "experiment_c_summary_v2_units.csv"),
  validation_summary = file.path("artefacts", "validation", "pilot_benchmark_v1", "pilot_metrics_summary_v1.csv"),
  stability_summary = file.path("artefacts", "stability", "long_horizon_v1", "stability_summary_v1.csv")
)

fig_paths <- list(
  exp_a = file.path("artefacts", "canonical_runs", "experiment_a_presence_removal_v2", "experiment_a_presence_removal_v2.png"),
  exp_c = file.path("artefacts", "canonical_runs", "experiment_c_aridity_gradient_v2", "experiment_c_aridity_gradient_v2.png")
)

exp_a_summary <- read_safe(paths$exp_a_summary)
exp_a_delta <- read_safe(paths$exp_a_delta)
exp_a_claims <- read_safe(paths$exp_a_claims)
exp_a_units <- read_safe(paths$exp_a_units)
exp_c_summary <- read_safe(paths$exp_c_summary)
exp_c_claims <- read_safe(paths$exp_c_claims)
exp_c_units <- read_safe(paths$exp_c_units)
validation_summary <- read_safe(paths$validation_summary)
stability_summary <- read_safe(paths$stability_summary)
```

## Overview

This report assembles post-1.0 artefacts with uncertainty summaries, explicit claim status tables, and ecological limitation statements.

## Experiment A v2 (Presence vs Removal)

```{r}
if (is.null(exp_a_summary)) {
  cat("Experiment A v2 summary is missing.")
} else {
  knitr::kable(exp_a_summary, digits = 3, caption = "Experiment A v2 scenario summary (units in companion table).")
}
```

```{r}
if (is.null(exp_a_delta)) {
  cat("Experiment A v2 delta summary is missing.")
} else {
  knitr::kable(exp_a_delta, digits = 3, caption = "Experiment A v2 delta ensemble summary (removal - present).")
}
```

```{r}
if (!is.null(exp_a_claims)) {
  knitr::kable(exp_a_claims, digits = 3, caption = "Experiment A v2 claim status.")
}
```

```{r}
if (!is.null(exp_a_units)) {
  knitr::kable(exp_a_units, digits = 3, caption = "Experiment A v2 metric units.")
}
```

```{r}
if (file.exists(fig_paths$exp_a)) {
  knitr::include_graphics(fig_paths$exp_a)
}
```

## Validation and Stability

```{r}

  cat("Pilot validation summary is missing.")
```


## Limitations

- Claim tables distinguish supported versus unsupported hypotheses.
- Optional claims remain visible even when unsupported, to prevent narrative overreach.
- Demography remains out of scope; stress trajectories are interpreted mechanistically.
